swallowed.instructions: This code catches an error and discards it, leaving no trace that it happened.

criteria.true: A catch (or except, or .catch) block is empty, or only continues, returns a default value or ignores the error, without logging, rethrowing, returning, wrapping or recording it.
criteria.false: Every catch here logs the error, rethrows it, wraps it in another error, returns or passes it to a caller, or records it somewhere; or the code catches nothing.
